name: Release v0.58.0
body:
## Release v0.58.0 with changes since v0.57.0

### Notable Changes

  - Fix HasDiff returning false when OwnerIds or ParentIds actually differ (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7137)
  - Fix out-of-bounds panic on empty DeployTargets in plugins (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7116)
  - Fix git worktree race condition issue (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7201)
  - Return 0 from sortFunc when values are equal (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7169)
  - Skip piped-config volume when launcher loads config from git (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7141)
  - Prevent nil-deref panic on invalid pem block (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7054)
  - Clean up cloned repo after skip stage check (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7021)
  - Guard zero startedAt timestamp in application detail (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7168)
  - Guard undefined hash in commit detail view and add regression test (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7148)
  - Fail fast on missing resources in pipectl (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7180)
  - Guard rollback stage builders against empty stage lists (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7002)
  - Paginate ListNotCompletedDeployments in pipedv1 (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/6727)
  - Return the cursor when listing applications without label filter (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7101)
  - Rename pipecd control plane chart to controlplane (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7114)

### New Features

  - Support config hash annotation for StatefulSets and DaemonSets (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7025)

###  Documentation

  - Add self-documenting make help target (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/6568)
  - Added Control Plane architecture diagram in Concepts page (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7043)
  - Add walkthrough of the WAIT plugin (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/6779)
  - Reorganize the v1 plugins section (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7122)
  - Add v1 stage plugin pages (wait, wait-approval, script-run) (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7078)
  - Add comprehensive piped configuration reference (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/6644)
  - Add blog post for PipeCD at KubeCon India 2026 (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7032)
  - Add AI usage guidelines to CONTRIBUTING.md (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/6815)
  - Update docs and READMEs to use controlplane after the pipecd rename (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7131)
  - Add Netlify configuration for docs hosting migration (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/6930)
  - Add contexts directory to web README directory structure (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7018)
  - Expand the Analysis plugin page (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7082)
  - Expand the Kubernetes plugin page (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7079)
  - Expand the Terraform plugin (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7081)
  - Add plugin tutorial section and Chapter 1 Introduction (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7139)
  - Added copyright year in website footer (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7045)
  - Move plugin configuration guides to plugins section (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/6698)
  - Add application configuration reference (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7022)
  - Add recap of July & August 2026 Newcomers meetings (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7181)
  - Split examples into v0 and v1 (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7173)
  - Fix copy-paste issue and wording changes (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7033)

  - Update golangci-lint version to fix CI warning (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7202)
  - Add coverage for isDeploymentRunning all enum values (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7145)
  - Topic website lighthouse performance (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7041)

  - Add CLAUDE.md importing copilot-instructions.md (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7123)
  - Rename pipecd control plane chart to controlplane (https://github.com/pipe-cd/pipecd/pull/7114)
